title: Make the citation checker able to fail. scripts/verify_audit_citations.py only greps SCR/FR/CALC id strings out of docs/*.md, so it passes a fabricated ui/src/main.tsx:145 citation. Extend it to resolve every file:line code citation by reading that line and checking the claimed token is on it, and ship a test that deliberately breaks one citation and asserts the checker reports it. Acceptance: a corrupted citation turns the gate red, demonstrated with the before/after output pasted in the handoff
